evals.prompt: Acabo de fusionar el Pull Request de mi rama feat/user-auth en GitHub. Limpia las ramas locales del repo.
evals.expected_output: The agent switches to the main branch (git switch main), pulls the changes (git pull) and runs git-cleanup (or runs git fetch --prune and checks that refs/remotes/origin/feat/user-auth is gone). It safely deletes the stale branch while protecting main and reports the result to the user. The reply is in Spanish.

evals.prompt: I have a lot of old local branches piled up after several squash merges. Delete them, but don't touch develop or main.
evals.expected_output: The agent explicitly protects main and develop (through git-cleanup arguments or the exclusion list in the native flow), runs the remote prune git fetch --prune, finds the local branches that no longer exist on origin and deletes them without trying to delete main or develop.
